scripts.name: Receive Trade

examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run receive trade -- --profile Mrathlete --from mrwood --item coins --min-amount 100000

scripts.name: Agent Chat XS
scripts.description: Sends, reads, or checks compact structured agent/player chat through the XS bridge primitives without using public game chat.

python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run agent chat -- --profile MrFlame send "hello" --channel agent

scripts.name: Remote Agent Bridge Claim
scripts.description: Claims a logged-in remote player through an operator HTTPS /agent gateway, writes the profile-scoped ignored bridge session file, and can verify observe_state_XXS without exposing the raw bridge port.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run remote claim -- --profile MrFlame --bridge-url https://agents.example.com --verify

scripts.name: Adaptive Agility Runner
scripts.description: Runs agility course laps through normal bridge gameplay, records per-step evidence, learns faster obstacle variants, and can stop at a target Agility level.

scripts.name: Agility Phase Runner
scripts.description: Runs the current Agility phase through course-specific wrappers, preferring the best available defined course for the current level band instead of requiring a raw course id at call time.

scripts.name: Gnome Course Runner
scripts.description: Runs the Gnome Agility Course phase through the shared course-wrapper path and is the current practical Agility runner while higher-level course definitions are still being added.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run gnome course runner -- --quiet

scripts.name: Agility Pyramid Runner
scripts.description: Course-specific wrapper for the Agility Pyramid phase. Uses the locally defined fast stair route and delegates obstacle execution to the adaptive agility runner.

scripts.name: Agility Runner Report
scripts.description: Summarizes adaptive agility runner JSONL logs by lap timing, XP/hour, per-step timing, failure reasons, and slowest steps without loading raw logs into Codex context.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run agility report -- --profile Mrathlete --course agility_pyramid_course --text

scripts.name: Agility Pyramid Travel Setup
scripts.description: Safely moves a selected profile from Lumbridge or Al Kharid to the Agility Pyramid start, requiring carried coins for the toll, Shantay pass, and full waterskins before any desert crossing.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run pyramid travel setup -- --profile Mrathlete

scripts.name: Barbarian Course Runner
scripts.description: Course-specific wrapper for the Barbarian Outpost Agility phase. It now targets the defined local course data and is the preferred post-35 Agility runner when the player can route to the outpost safely.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run barbarian course runner -- --quiet

scripts.name: Barbarian Outpost Course Runner
scripts.description: Course-specific runner for the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course 35-65 phase. Targets the course start at 2551,3554,0 and delegates obstacle execution to the adaptive agility runner.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run barbarian outpost runner -- --profile Mrathlete

scripts.name: Sequential Progression Runner
scripts.description: Runs the prepared selected-profile progression phases in order: leather completion and sellout, bronze-to-15 Smithing plus iron mining, thieving to 20, then Agility progression through the current phase runner.

scripts.name: Adaptive Mining Runner
scripts.description: Discovers cache-backed mine clusters, routes between banks and rocks, chooses the best live ore target, mines with primitive find_nearest_rock plus interact_object loops by default, keeps legacy mining-tool fallback for old runtimes, banks ores for Mining training, and logs run-policy plus route-batch run-efficiency diagnostics.

scripts.name: Falador Mining Guild Runner
scripts.description: Location-specific Mining Guild wrapper that routes between Falador East Bank and the guild ladders, mines a selected ore through the primitive mining runner, banks coal/gems/products, and keeps the best usable pickaxe equipped.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run falador mining guild -- --max-loads 1

scripts.name: Adaptive Fletching Runner
scripts.description: Runs normal-gameplay woodcutting and fletching loops with primitive-first tree object interaction, knife-on-log fletching, and interface-button make-all clicks, legacy fallback for old runtimes, bird nest pickup/banking, product selling, run enabling, quiet progress, and JSONL evidence.

scripts.name: Seers Yew Longbow Runner
scripts.description: Seers Village yew longbow wrapper around the proven Seers fletching loop, with independent profile-scoped status/stop files, a yew tree route anchor, product banking, bird-nest pickup, and tiny shutdown-status polling.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run seers yew -- --profile PROFILE --shutdown-status

scripts.name: Yew Longbow Stringer
scripts.description: Profile-scoped bank runner that strings yew longbow (u) with bow strings into yew longbows using normal withdraw, calibrated exact-tick stringing waits, immediate bank/deposit loops, and compact primitives. It supports status and cooperative stop files.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run string yews -- --profile PROFILE --status

scripts.name: Falador Willow Longbow Selloff
scripts.description: Profile-scoped Falador cleanup helper that withdraws only banked willow longbow (u) as notes, sells them to the Falador general store, and returns to Falador east bank to bank the sale coins without touching yew bow stock.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run sell willow longs -- --profile PROFILE

scripts.name: Magic Training Runner
scripts.description: Profile-scoped Magic combat runner that selects standard combat spells, equips an air staff, manages food and runes, trains on safe nearby NPCs, and records compact Magic XP run logs.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run magic training -- --profile PROFILE --max-rounds 20

scripts.name: Magic Campaign Runner
scripts.description: Long-running profile-scoped Magic campaign runner that restocks runes, prepares bank loadouts, routes to training targets, runs Magic training batches, and writes campaign status/log artifacts.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run magic campaign -- --profile PROFILE --status

scripts.name: Primitive Woodcutting Runner
scripts.description: Runs standalone woodcutting through primitive find_nearest_tree, interact_object, wait_until_idle, route, bank, and bird-nest pickup steps without using Java woodcutting batch tools.

scripts.name: Seers Flax Bowstring Runner
scripts.description: Reusable profile-aware Seers Village flax loop that picks flax, climbs to the spinning wheel, spins bowstrings with primitive item/object and interface clicks, banks products, supports cooperative status/stop files, and uses compact bridge state.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run seers flax -- --profile PROFILE --max-cycles 1

scripts.name: Fast Seers Flax Spin Runner
scripts.description: Fast Seers Village flax picker and bowstring spinner with low-overhead tick-analysis events, cached flax selection, compact bridge calls, exact-tick spinning waits, cooperative status/stop files, and tiny shutdown-status polling.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run seers flax fast -- --profile PROFILE --shutdown-status

scripts.name: Seers Bowstring Yew Master
scripts.description: Profile-scoped master runner that alternates the fast Seers flax-to-bowstring runner with bank-based yew longbow stringing at Seers bank, while exposing compact status and cooperative stop controls.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run seers master -- --profile PROFILE --shutdown-status

scripts.name: Seers Yew Complete Bow Master
scripts.description: Profile-scoped master runner that makes finished yew longbows by switching between existing Seers yew chop/fletch, fast flax-to-bowstring, and yew-longbow stringing runners. It prioritizes stringing pairable supplies first and exposes compact status plus cooperative stop controls.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run complete yew bows -- --profile PROFILE --shutdown-status

scripts.name: Runner Tick Analysis Report
scripts.description: Summarizes low-overhead runner timing JSONL logs into compact cycle, item-arrival, route, and slow-event reports so agents do not need to read raw logs.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run tick analysis -- --latest --runner seers-flax-spin-fast --profile PROFILE

scripts.name: Seers Crafting Plan Runner
scripts.description: Standalone Crafting plan runner that bootstraps to level 10 with Catherby charter glass supplies and Ardougne furnace glassmaking, then continues with the reusable Seers flax-to-bowstring loop. Requires CustomFeatureFlags.CATHERBY_TRADER_STAN_AND_GLASSMAKING_ENABLED, which defaults disabled.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run crafting plan -- --profile PROFILE --max-flax-cycles 1

scripts.name: Cowhide Combat Runner
scripts.description: Runs tight normal-gameplay cow combat for selected-profile early melee training: stays local inside the Lumbridge cow pen while reachable cows exist, handles the timed cow-pen gate transition, uses short fight/drop polling for fast Cowhide pickup, banks hides at Al Kharid through the compact bank-loadout policy, buys/eats kebabs as needed, can buy/equip Mithril scimitar when Attack allows, records JSONL evidence, exposes profile-scoped cooperative --status/--request-stop control files, and currently uses legacy route_runner.py compatibility paths only for real travel legs.

scripts.name: Bank Loadout Helper
scripts.description: Applies compact primitive-backed bank loadout policies from observed inventory so scripts do not repeatedly deposit the same item; includes a cowhide-trip preset for banking hides and the spare iron scimitar while keeping three kebabs and 100 coins.

scripts.name: Primitive Combat Runner
scripts.description: Runs generic combat training or target killing from external script logic using set_combat_style, find_training_npc, attack_npc, wait_until_idle, eat_best_food, optional looting, and optional route targets instead of Java train_combat or durable combat goal strategy.

scripts.name: Al Kharid Warrior Combat Runner
scripts.description: Bespoke Al Kharid Warrior trip runner for early melee training near Al Kharid bank. Uses ML1 routing through the shared primitive trip loop, equips banked combat gear, carries cheap food first, keeps a coin float for toll/food, fights with direct styles, loots runes/herbs/coins/useful stackables, buries bones, banks and restocks.

scripts.name: Chaos Druid Combat Runner
scripts.description: Bespoke Chaos Druid trip runner for Edgeville dungeon training after base-25 melee. Uses the shared primitive trip loop for ML1 routing, food/restock, direct style cycling, herb/rune/coin loot banking, and bone burying.

scripts.name: White Knight Combat Runner
scripts.description: Bespoke Falador White Knight trip runner for 1-food melee training. Prefers reachable outdoor/courtyard White Knights, banks useful drops only at full inventory or when food is consumed, picks up and buries bones, and cycles direct Attack/Strength/Defence styles.

scripts.name: Moss Giant Combat Runner
scripts.description: Bespoke Moss Giant trip runner for the later base-60 melee push. Uses the shared primitive trip loop with stronger food, big-bone burying, useful stackable loot banking, and direct style cycling.

scripts.name: Primitive Food Runner
scripts.description: Runs fishing, cooking, fish-then-cook, or firemaking through interact_npc, use_item_on_object, use_item_on_item, click_interface_button, and wait_until_idle instead of Java fish_food, cook_food, or light_fire strategy tools.

scripts.name: Catherby Food Runner
scripts.description: Runs Catherby fish, cook, drop-burnt, and bank cycles with proven local shore/range/bank fast paths plus ML1 fallback, Catherby south range-house door handling, fishing-spot reacquisition, level-aware method selection (shrimp, rod+bait sardine/herring, shrimp/anchovies, tuna, lobster, tuna/swordfish), Catherby fishing-shop supply buying, progress checks, compact bank policy deposits, optional post-cook inventory handoff for supervising sale wrappers, cooperative status/stop controls, passive-trace efficiency reporting, and stale-runtime cook_food fallback only when primitive cooking makes no progress.

scripts.name: Road to 99 Fishing and Cooking
scripts.description: Long-running Mrfish-style wrapper around the Catherby Food Runner. Before Cooking gauntlets, runs one proven Catherby fish/cook cycle at a time, keeps cooked fish in inventory, sells directly at Arhein, deposits coins, sells lobsters too instead of reserving food, buys/equips Cooking gauntlets from Caleb at 25k coins, then switches back to banking all food while continuing toward 99 Fishing and 99 Cooking.

scripts.name: Catherby Food Runner XS
scripts.description: Extra-slim status/control wrapper for the Catherby fish/cook/bank runner. Combines cooperative status and passive-trace efficiency into one compact JSON response; delegates request-stop/clear-stop safely.

scripts.name: Runner Status XS
scripts.description: Compact status reader for cooperative gameplay runners. For Catherby food runs it reports state, reason, player, stop files, route evidence path, and passive-trace efficiency without touching the live game.

scripts.name: Food Bank XS
scripts.description: Compact food, bank, equipment, and inventory summary for cooking, fishing, banking, and combat-prep decisions without loading a full observe_state payload.

scripts.name: Object Search XS
scripts.description: Compact object search wrapper. On failed object lookup it returns nearby object candidates so agents can adjust name, id, or reachability without a full observation.

scripts.name: Primitive Smithing Runner
scripts.description: Runs smelting and smithing externally using reusable bridge primitives such as smelt_bar, object interaction, interface-item smithing selection, wait_until_idle, and SmithingData parsing instead of Java smith_item, smith_best_item, plan_smithing, or train_smithing_profit strategy calls.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run smithing -- --mode smelt --bar bronze --quiet

scripts.name: Al Kharid Bronze Prep Runner
scripts.description: Phase-specific Smithing-30 prep wrapper that mines balanced Al Kharid copper/tin with a rune pickaxe, smelts bronze at the Al Kharid furnace, and stops once banked bronze can finish level 30 Smithing.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run bronze prep -- --profile MrFlame --quiet

scripts.name: Varrock Bronze Smith Runner
scripts.description: Phase-specific wrapper that routes to Varrock west bank, withdraws hammer and bronze bars, smiths at Varrock west anvils, banks products, and stops at the target Smithing level.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run varrock bronze smith -- --profile MrFlame --quiet

scripts.name: Al Kharid Steel Smelter
scripts.description: Phase-specific wrapper that smelts banked iron ore and coal into steel bars at Al Kharid furnace using 9-steel inventory loads and banks each batch.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run steel smelter -- --profile MrFlame --quiet

scripts.name: Mining and Smithing Goal Runner
scripts.description: Orchestrates Mining and Smithing targets by composing the existing mining, bronze/iron metals, smelting, smithing, banking, furnace, and anvil runners. Uses Varrock east iron mining, Al Kharid furnace smelting, and Varrock west anvils.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run mining smithing -- --profile PROFILE --target-mining-level 30 --target-smithing-level 30 --quiet

scripts.name: ML1 Route Definition
scripts.description: Preferred ML1 route API for normal A-to-B routing. Returns compact routeSteps, runPlan/runSegments, safety review fields, persisted route-definition artifacts, and feedback commands. Use define before live travel; bare route_runner.py is deprecated for normal agent routing.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run ml1 -- define --from X,Y,H --to PLACE --combat-level N --food N --run-energy N --run-enabled
python3 agent-navigation/ml-routing/route_ml.py define --from X,Y,H --to PLACE --combat-level N --food N --run-energy N --run-enabled

scripts.name: ML1 Route Step Executor
scripts.description: Executes a persisted ML1 route definition by following routeSteps through normal bridge walk primitives, eating at a safer default HP threshold, observing nearby NPC context on combat or HP loss, and writing route_batch plus route_outcome evidence for future ML exports.

scripts.name: Route Failure XS
scripts.description: Compact reader for ML1 route executor evidence. Reports latest route outcome, last batch, combat/death/HP-loss failures, final tile, and route evidence path without loading full executor logs.

scripts.name: Route Runner (Deprecated)
scripts.description: Deprecated standalone route method. Keep for legacy diagnostics and compatibility executor checks only; normal agent routing should use ML1 route_ml.py define and follow routeSteps.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run legacy-route -- --to ardougne --orient --json --run-reserve auto

scripts.name: Marathon Runner
scripts.description: Runs repeated route/exploration laps with route-eval preflight and suspicious-detour context maps.

scripts.name: Runtime Doctor
scripts.description: Checks, restarts, claims, verifies, and inspects the local server/client/bridge runtime without printing bridge tokens.

scripts.name: Runtime Data Backup
scripts.description: Archives deployed runtime data directories and writes a readiness-compatible proof note for character saves, PBKDF2 account records, and Discord secrets without touching the running server, optionally updating runtime_data_backup_proof_file in a deployment proof manifest; refuses symlinked runtime-data or output paths.

scripts.name: Desktop Client Proof
scripts.description: Writes a readiness-compatible desktop client coexistence proof note from an existing same-host plus external Java client observation and a real non-symlink screenshot/log evidence file, optionally updating desktop_client_proof_file in a deployment proof manifest.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run desktop_client_proof -- --same-host-client LocalTest --external-client ExternalTest --transport tailscale --public-host HOST --evidence /path/to/evidence.png --proof-manifest dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json

python3 scripts/write-desktop-client-proof.py --same-host-client LocalTest --external-client ExternalTest --transport client_tls_tunnel --public-host HOST --evidence /path/to/evidence.log --output dist/external-deployment/desktop-client-proof.md --proof-manifest dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json

scripts.name: Deployment Proof Bundle
scripts.description: Packages non-secret deployment proof handoff artifacts from a prepared deployment directory or explicit readiness/proof paths, including reports, a filled proof manifest, proof notes, and selected client/server metadata while deliberately excluding runtime backup archives, character saves, account records, and secrets. Use --require-full-proof for the final external-ready bundle.
examples: python3 scripts/package-deployment-proof.py --readiness-report dist/deployment-readiness-report.md --readiness-json dist/deployment-readiness-report.json --proof-manifest dist/deployment-proof-manifest.json --client-dist dist/2006scape-client --server-deployment-dir dist/server-deployment

scripts.name: External Config Preflight
scripts.description: Statically checks external-player ServerConfig JSON for safe bind hosts, secure transport acknowledgement, account-auth lockdown, bridge non-exposure, and placeholder/wildcard mistakes before startup.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run external config preflight -- "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.External.Sample.json"

scripts.name: External Deployment Prepare
scripts.description: Packages the standalone client, renders server deployment artifacts, optional tunnel templates, proof templates, proof-manifest template, and readiness reports without starting or stopping the runtime.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run prepare external deployment -- --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json"

scripts.name: Standalone Client Package
scripts.description: Packages the downloadable Java desktop client folder and zip from an external-player ServerConfig, including launcher scripts, macOS double-click .command wrappers, setup-check scripts, client.properties, source config hash manifest, checksums, transport guidance, and symlinked output path rejection.
examples: CLIENT_SERVER_CONFIG="2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run package client

scripts.name: Client TLS Tunnel Config
scripts.description: Renders player-side and operator-side stunnel templates for client_tls_tunnel deployments so the legacy plaintext client can use an encrypted external path.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run client tls tunnel -- --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" --output-dir dist/client-tls-tunnel-operator

scripts.name: Server Deployment Files
scripts.description: Renders operator-side systemd, environment, firewall, README, copied config, proof-note templates, and a proof-manifest template for VPS/GCE-style external-player deployments.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run server deployment files -- --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" --output-dir dist/server-deployment

scripts.name: External Deployment Verify
scripts.description: Verifies packaged client artifacts, checksums, archive contents, account records, Discord secrets, server deployment templates, optional client_tls_tunnel operator stunnel templates, and optional live reachability/login proof.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run verify external deployment -- --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" --client-dist dist/2006scape-client --server-deployment-dir dist/server-deployment --client-tls-tunnel-dir dist/client-tls-tunnel-operator

scripts.name: Deployment Network Probe
scripts.description: Performs focused live public game/cache reachability and agent-bridge non-exposure proof from ServerConfig without packaging, building, login, or runtime restart.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run network proof -- --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json"

scripts.name: Agent Chat Log Verify
scripts.description: Verifies sanitized AgentChatService JSONL log entries for deployment proof, especially Discord-to-server ingestion, direct player delivery status, and blocked-route absence checks; can update deployment-proof-manifest chat proof fields with --proof-manifest.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run agent chat log proof -- --text-contains MARKER --from-type discord --from-bot false --channel agent --proof-manifest dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json
python3 scripts/verify-agent-chat-log.py --text-contains MARKER --from-type discord --from-bot false --channel agent --proof-manifest dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json

python3 scripts/verify-agent-chat-log.py --event agent_chat_player_delivery --text-contains MARKER --to-type player --to-name PLAYER --delivered-to PLAYER --no-undelivered --channel agent --proof-manifest dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json

scripts.name: Discord Channel Message Verify
scripts.description: Verifies a recent configured-bot-authored Discord channel message for server-to-Discord mirroring proof; can update deployment-proof-manifest Discord mirror fields with --proof-manifest.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run discord channel proof -- --text-contains MARKER --agent PROFILE --proof-manifest dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json

scripts.name: Deployment Readiness Report
scripts.description: Writes redacted Markdown and optional JSON readiness reports that separate command success from live/manual deployment proof coverage for external-player releases, including optional client_tls_tunnel operator template verification, JSON proof-manifest input, and success-only --update-proof-manifest output.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run deployment readiness -- --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" --client-dist dist/2006scape-client --server-deployment-dir dist/server-deployment --client-tls-tunnel-dir dist/client-tls-tunnel-operator

python3 scripts/deployment-readiness-report.py --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" --client-dist dist/2006scape-client --server-deployment-dir dist/server-deployment --proof-manifest dist/deployment-proof-manifest.json

python3 scripts/deployment-readiness-report.py --config "2006Scape Server/ServerConfig.json" --client-dist dist/2006scape-client --server-deployment-dir dist/server-deployment --json-output dist/deployment-readiness-report.json

scripts.name: Deployment Readiness Status
scripts.description: Reads an existing deployment-readiness JSON report and prints the command status, deploymentProofStatus, externallyReady decision, proof coverage, remaining live-proof items, and optional next-command templates without running probes or touching runtime.

scripts.name: Deployment Proof Manifest Check
scripts.description: Checks a copied deployment-proof-manifest JSON for known fields, placeholder values, raw secret mistakes, full-proof completeness, optional Discord/blocked-routing proof fields, and optional env/file presence without running deployment verification.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run proof manifest check -- dist/external-deployment/deployment-proof-manifest.json --require-full-proof

scripts.name: External Account Create
scripts.description: Creates or rotates ignored PBKDF2 account records for external auth with owner-only permissions, password-policy metadata, optional roles, allowed characters, and Discord user id. Supply real passwords through an environment variable named by --password-env, not as command arguments.
examples: read -s ACCOUNT_PASSWORD && export ACCOUNT_PASSWORD && python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run external_account_create -- ExternalTest --password-env ACCOUNT_PASSWORD --allowed-character ExternalTest
read -s ACCOUNT_PASSWORD && export ACCOUNT_PASSWORD && python3 scripts/create-account.py ExternalTest --password-env ACCOUNT_PASSWORD --overwrite --preserve-metadata

scripts.name: External Account Admin
scripts.description: Audits, lists, shows, disables, or enables ignored PBKDF2 account records without rotating passwords. Use --require-password-policy audit before packaging or live proof.

scripts.name: Game Login Probe
scripts.description: Performs focused game-protocol login probes over raw TCP or TLS tunnel endpoints, including expected-failure and expected-status checks for auth rejection proof.
examples: LIVE_LOGIN_PASSWORD="throwaway password" python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run game login probe -- --host HOST --port 43594 --username USER --password-env LIVE_LOGIN_PASSWORD
LIVE_LOGIN_PASSWORD="wrong password" python3 scripts/probe-game-login.py --host HOST --port 43594 --username USER --password-env LIVE_LOGIN_PASSWORD --expect-failure --expect-statuses 3,4

scripts.name: Concurrent Login Probe
scripts.description: Proves one external game-protocol login and one same-host loopback login can stay open concurrently without launching GUI clients.
examples: EXTERNAL_PASSWORD="throwaway external password" LOCAL_PASSWORD="throwaway local password" python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run concurrent login proof -- --external-host HOST --external-username EXTERNAL_TEST --external-password-env EXTERNAL_PASSWORD --local-username LOCAL_TEST --local-password-env LOCAL_PASSWORD

EXTERNAL_PASSWORD="throwaway external password" LOCAL_PASSWORD="throwaway local password" python3 scripts/probe-concurrent-logins.py --external-host HOST --external-port 43594 --external-username EXTERNAL_TEST --external-password-env EXTERNAL_PASSWORD --local-host 127.0.0.1 --local-port 43594 --local-username LOCAL_TEST --local-password-env LOCAL_PASSWORD

scripts.name: Discord Agent Probe
scripts.description: Authenticates configured agent Discord bot tokens and checks channel reachability without posting unless explicitly requested.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run discord probe -- --secrets "2006Scape Server/data/secrets.json"

scripts.name: Agent Session XS
scripts.description: Compact latest/current agent-session log reader. Summarizes top tools, recent outcomes, failures, current player state, and log paths without loading large JSONL or Markdown files into context.

scripts.name: Server Tick Report
scripts.description: Summarizes recent /tmp/2006scape-server.log cycle-duration warnings, sampled slow cycles, and tick health in compact JSON without restarting or touching the live JVM.

scripts.name: Map Grid API
scripts.description: Converts level-0 world tiles to 32-tile reference grid cells, returns cell bounds, and lists grid cells visible in bounded maps.

scripts.name: Agent Context Map
scripts.description: Renders bounded current-location, grid-cell, or route-segment cache maps with nearby markers, the level-0 reference grid, and machine-readable JSON summaries.

scripts.name: Active Map Refresher
scripts.description: Starts, stops, restarts, and inspects the profile-scoped background worker that keeps the three active map PNGs current for the selected profile: profile movement, Heat Map, and profile fog.

scripts.name: Profile Movement Map
scripts.description: Renders the active profile movement map with latest movement traces, cache icons, labels, run tinting, death sites, and current-position marker.

scripts.name: Heat Map
scripts.description: Renders the active movement heat map with latest traces and full-resolution cached coverage density.

scripts.name: Profile Fog
scripts.description: Renders the active fog-of-war movement map with latest traces, dark unexplored context, and POIs hidden outside explored coverage.

scripts.name: Character Memory
scripts.description: Reads and writes sparse profile-scoped long-term memories and goals for a selected character without mixing MrFlame, MrGem, or other profiles.
examples: python3 agent-navigation/tools/script_registry.py run character-memory -- show --profile PROFILE --json
python3 agent-navigation/tools/character_memory.py goal --profile PROFILE --priority normal --tags gear --text "Upgrade from a bronze axe when the character has enough coins and shop access."

scripts.name: Navigation Database CLI
scripts.description: Validates and queries navigation places, routes, hazards, passive traces, coverage, and route graph summaries.

scripts.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena Runner
scripts.description: Brimhaven Agility Arena physical course runner. Enters through Cap'n Izzy, keeps run enabled, crosses nearby arena obstacles toward active dispensers, tags tickets only when physically near the target platform, exchanges with Pirate Jackie, can bank-restock food/coins, and records compact obstacle/ticket/XP evidence.
